idle.body: {minutes} minutes on this one thing. The clock runs on its own, so close the tab, reload, come back; it keeps the time for you.

running.label: Time remaining
running.hint: Nothing else needs you right now.

busy.title: A session is already running
busy.body: One at a time. End it, or go back and finish it.

missing.title: That task isn't on this device
missing.body: It may have been deleted, or created in another browser. Tasks live on the device that made them.

box-breathing.title: Box breathing
box-breathing.body: In for four, hold for four, out for four, hold for four. Four rounds is plenty.

long-exhale.title: One long exhale
long-exhale.body: Breathe in through your nose, then let the air out slowly, twice as long as it took to come in.

one-breath.title: Just one breath
one-breath.body: One slow breath, paying attention to the whole of it. That's the entire exercise.

eyes-off-screen.title: Look away
eyes-off-screen.body: Find something at least six metres off and rest your eyes on it. Screens ask them to stay at one distance for too long.

window-gaze.title: Out of the window
window-gaze.body: Pick one thing outside and watch it for a while. Weather counts. Pigeons count.

water.title: Get some water
water.body: Fill a glass, drink it standing up. The walk there is part of it.

do-nothing.title: Do nothing
do-nothing.body: Not your phone, not a quick email. Sit still and be a bit bored for five minutes. It is allowed.

shoulder-roll.title: Roll your shoulders
shoulder-roll.body: Five slow circles back, five forward. Notice where they were sitting before you started.

neck-release.title: Let your neck go
neck-release.body: Lower one ear towards your shoulder and breathe there for a few seconds. Then the other side. No pulling.

stand-and-reach.title: Stand and reach up
stand-and-reach.body: Straighten up, reach both arms overhead, breathe in. Lower them slowly on the way out.

walk-it-out.title: Walk somewhere else
walk-it-out.body: Another room, the corridor, the end of the street. Anywhere that isn't this chair.

shake-it-off.title: Shake it off
shake-it-off.body: Stand up and shake out your hands, arms and legs for thirty seconds. Looks silly, works anyway.
